---
title: undici-types
tags: #librerias, #typescript, #npm
---

This package is a dual-publish of the [[undici]] library types. The `undici` package **still contains types**. This package is for users who _only_ need undici types (such as for `@types/node`). It is published alongside every release of `undici`, so you can always use the same version.

- [GitHub nodejs/undici](https://github.com/nodejs/undici)
- [Undici Documentation](https://undici.nodejs.org/#/)
